family: fresh mux of arbitrary Boolean G(s,X),H(s,Y), two shared bits and disjoint private blocks

pilot.domain: all 256 three-bit G against all 16 two-bit H; private G bit2, H no private; two calibrated references

full.domain: all 256 three-bit G against all 256 three-bit H; private G and H bits separately embedded
full.reference_cases: fixed labelled menu first 16 G and first 16 H (256), two references

arithmetic: integer FWHT, Fraction, exact prime-log vectors and outward rational 32-term atanh bounds with proved remainder
